cards.title: Control path
cards.purpose: Separate pilot command shaping from airframe response
conditions: normal, sport and full where applicable
radio inputs retain documented external shaping
procedure: Apply repeatable small and endpoint stick commands.
Compare raw input, demand and actual surface angle.
cards.acceptance: Conformance to declared software configuration only; no physical servo target inferred.

cards.title: Trim and tracking
cards.purpose: Separate trim, disturbance response and required pilot correction
conditions: matched speed, power, mass and weather
upright and inverted trims treated separately
procedure: Establish trim over a selected speed grid.
Measure line tracking and correction effort.
Apply small pitch/roll pulses and release.
cards.acceptance: No invented numerical real-aircraft threshold; record reproducible curves for comparison.

cards.title: Roll response
cards.purpose: Separate authority, damping, inertia and actuator lag
procedure: Run matched stick pulses.
Repeat with matched actual surface deflection.
Measure acceleration and stopping as well as peak/steady rate.
cards.acceptance: Use small-disturbance analysis only in its valid regime.

cards.title: Slow flight and stall
cards.purpose: Distinguish low-rate mush from wing drop and aggressive stall entry
conditions: recorded CG, fuel and actual elevator
procedure: Decelerate from repeatable trimmed state.
Log alpha, speed, sideslip and controls.
Compare entry, held state and recovery separately.
cards.acceptance: Qualitative reports are hypotheses; do not force every stall to be benign.

cards.title: Knife-edge and coupling
procedure: Measure sink and pitch/roll correction demand.
Compare equal-speed cases before changing propulsion or CG.
Compute idealized required CY separately from available force.
cards.acceptance: No inference of zero bare-airframe coupling from a compensated flight.

cards.title: Approach and flare
cards.purpose: Separate airborne energy dissipation from ground contact
conditions: matched entry airspeed, height, fuel and wind
procedure: Measure approach sink and flare duration/distance.
Record touchdown separately.
Evaluate rollout only after contact.
cards.acceptance: Do not alter wheel friction to fit an airborne float discrepancy.

cards.title: Snap and spin classification
cards.purpose: Distinguish stalled autorotation from axial roll or accelerating spiral
conditions: actual rates and entry energy recorded
procedure: Track alpha, speed and angular rates throughout entry and hold.
Describe recovery controls and residual turns.
Validate a held-out maneuver after any calibration.
cards.acceptance: Rotation alone is insufficient to classify a spin; no imported full-scale rotation target.

cards.title: Fuel and balance sensitivity
cards.purpose: Separate mass, CG and inertia effects
conditions: same declared propulsion, density and input setup
procedure: Recompute actual state properties.
Obtain fresh trims at each inventory.
Compare both matched-tape and freshly trimmed maneuvers.
cards.acceptance: Square-root loading relation is an algebraic reference, not full nonlinear prediction.
